name: Shire Intelligence
long_description: Shire is an AI floor manager for full-service restaurants, running on the cameras they already have. It sees what a great manager sees: a guest ready to order, a table waiting on the check, a four-top that needs clearing, a server that is double booked. Then it acts, alerting staff in the moment and seating each new party with the server who has room. A POS only knows what gets typed into it. Shire knows what is happening in the room, so wait-time quotes, staffing, and pricing run on real turn times.
one_liner: Shire uses CCTV to run restaurants in real time.

launches.title: Shire Intelligence: Giving restaurants software eyes
launches.tagline: Shire uses CCTV to run restaurants in real time.
launches.body:
**Shire (YC F26)** turns existing restaurant cameras into a real-time operations layer, giving every restaurant the equivalent of five great general managers. **Shire is live in 13 restaurants and is rapidly growing.**\
\
<https://youtu.be/WyPUArKoZLg>

Restaurants depend on great managers to keep service running smoothly. They watch the floor, notice when guests need attention, keep servers from getting overwhelmed, and make hundreds of small decisions throughout a shift.

But even the best manager can't watch every table at once. Guests wait to order, dirty tables sit empty, and one server gets slammed while another has nothing to do.

Traditional restaurant software doesn't solve this. A POS knows when an order was entered or a check was closed, but almost nothing about what happens in between.

**Shire gives restaurant software eyes.**

Using cameras restaurants already have, Shire understands what's happening across the dining room and helps staff respond in real time. It can:

* Notify servers when guests are ready to order or pay
* Alert staff when tables need clearing
* Seat parties based on each server's live workload
* Help restaurants optimize staffing, reservations, pricing, and table turns using what actually happens during service

This also unlocks a new kind of restaurant software. No more estimating wait times from historical averages: Shire can see how far tables are through their meals. Instead of staffing around last week's sales, restaurants can make decisions based on actual workloads and service patterns.

We believe restaurant software should do more than record transactions. It should understand what's happening in the restaurant and help run it.

**Built by restaurant operators, for restaurant operators**

We're Math, EECS, and MechE dropouts who have spent years working in restaurants. Cameron and Alex have known each other since kindergarten and spent years working together in restaurants. Alex went on to manage two large restaurants, while Cameron worked on the front lines of service. Harshith brings deep technical experience, having published graph research in _Nature_ and built reinforcement learning systems for real-world operations at Bastazo. After a year of building together, the three of us left Duke and Clemson to work on Shire full-time.

**Early results**

Across the restaurants that are live, Shire has reduced table turn time by **12%** on average.

We're now looking to partner with more restaurant owners, operators, restaurant groups, and POS distributors who want to run more efficient restaurants.
